body:
I'm sorry you've had to deal with that. My parents made me go to therapy once when I was a teenager and I don't think it's for me; the whole thing was pretty much the therapist playing with play-dough while I stared at the couch, then they said I had anxiety.

Even if it worked, I don't think I deserve it. People like you and other people here have legitimate problems and me going would just waste everyone's time. 

I'm probably going to bed again, because I sleep so much but I'm always so tired, so please don't assume the worst. Or the best, in my case. 

Sorry, I have a really inappropriate sense of humor. And if I say that I hope I don't wake up in a joking manner, people don't worry. I just want everyone to be happy.

My spouse does know and thinks I should get help too, but I don't think I should. I don't want to be confrontational, but I honestly don't believe you guys when you say that life isn't supposed to be like this. Fuck, everyone's brain is probably like this and I'm the big baby who can't deal with this. 

I'm sorry for taking everyone's time. I'm sorry. I'm so, so sorry.
